note: Fictional. Structure only from a press report on school places withdrawn after address checks; every person, the visit, the lost notes and the emergency form are invented. A mother used her grandmother's flat, 300 metres from an oversubscribed East London primary, while caring for her; she kept her own flat two miles away. The grandmother has died, the visit notes are lost, and the place can be withdrawn. Conversations take place 2-8 November 2026.
